headline: Where Luxury Becomes Meaning

blocks.text: At what point does an object stop being merchandise and become something a culture remembers?

blocks.text: Touch Me Not — The Mystery of Luxury, by Gregory Gray and Olivia Dhordain, began with a disagreement about whether that question could be measured. The experiment produced a Canon, a method and a more difficult discovery: the mystery often survives because somebody knows what not to do.
blocks.html: Touch Me Not — The Mystery of Luxury, by Gregory Gray and Olivia Dhordain, began with a disagreement about whether that question could be measured. The experiment produced a Canon, a method and a more difficult discovery: the mystery often survives because somebody knows what not to do.

headline: The Argument

cells: Price and fame can tell us what a market recognises. They cannot, by themselves, explain why meaning endures.
An object can carry a house. Sometimes the house is carrying the object, long after its own authority has weakened.
The most consequential acts are frequently those not taken: licences refused, editions withheld, production constrained, archives kept alive.
A disciplined instrument can examine the conditions of aura. It cannot manufacture aura or guarantee future value.

headline: What Is the House Known For?

blocks.text: A watch can have flawless finishing and no distinctive point of view. A piece of jewellery may show exceptional craft while the story belongs more to a technique than to any particular object. We examine the relationship between authorship, iconic references, edition policy, provenance, aftercare and the institutions that keep these objects meaningful. The question is not simply how to attract more attention. It is which parts of the proposition deserve to be made more legible and which should remain deliberately difficult to obtain.

blocks.text: Can an icon be protected through communications alone?
blocks.html: Can an icon be protected through communications alone?

blocks.text: No. Communications can help sustain a coherent narrative, but product decisions, rights, production discipline and governance determine what the house can actually protect.

headline: Talk It Through

blocks.text: A considered conversation can help identify what matters, which questions remain open and whether further work is useful. We will listen first. Clarity matters whether or not we go on to work together.
